label: Perception
inputs: sensory observations generated from task-relevant latent state plus nuisance variables
required_behavior: recover enough latent task state from current sensory evidence to choose the correct task action under held-out nuisance remints
minimal_negative_twin: replace the ambiguous sensory channel by a sufficient task-state symbol while preserving rewards, actions, seeds, and budgets + N0
strongest_parent: best policy measurable from frozen surface-cue features whose training correlations are intentionally broken by nuisance remints + P0
falsifier: the parent envelope matches the candidate in positive worlds; performance depends on forbidden latent labels; or the candidate-parent margin does not collapse when perceptual ambiguity is removed

label: Selective attention
inputs: a distractor-rich observation set with a strict sensing/compute budget
required_behavior: allocate limited observation or computation to task-relevant elements and improve normalized task utility relative to nonselective allocation
minimal_negative_twin: remove distractors or make every item equally relevant while keeping the same budget + N0
strongest_parent: best uniform, fixed-order, or task-independent allocation using the same observations and resource budget + P0
falsifier: nonselective allocation matches the candidate; relevance can be read from forbidden labels; or removing the selection problem does not collapse the advantage

label: Working memory
inputs: sequences containing an earlier cue that is absent at decision time and must be retained over a bounded delay
required_behavior: produce the cue-dependent decision after delay for collision pairs sharing the same current observation
minimal_negative_twin: make the required cue available again at decision time or reduce delay to zero + N0
strongest_parent: best policy measurable from current observation and public task state only + P0
falsifier: current-state parent matches the candidate on collision pairs; history leaks into the current observation; or the margin persists when the cue is restored

label: Episodic memory
inputs: event streams with unique event identity, item-context bindings, and later event-specific queries
required_behavior: retrieve event-specific item-context facts that cannot be inferred from aggregate semantic frequencies
minimal_negative_twin: replace event-specific queries by queries answerable from aggregate statistics + N0
strongest_parent: best semantic/aggregate predictor invariant to event identity + P0
falsifier: aggregate statistics predict the answers; event IDs leak target labels; or the episodic advantage survives when event identity is irrelevant

label: Semantic memory
inputs: multiple episodes sampled from stable cross-episode regularities plus episode-specific noise
required_behavior: recover cross-episode regularities and answer held-out semantic queries without exact episode replay
minimal_negative_twin: randomize the regularity independently per episode so no stable semantic fact exists + N0
strongest_parent: best episode-specific lookup/replay policy under the same storage and query budget + P0
falsifier: episode lookup matches held-out semantic generalization; train/test identity leaks; or the semantic margin remains when facts are randomized per episode

label: Procedural memory
inputs: repeated skill executions with reusable action structure and charged deliberation cost
required_behavior: reduce execution/deliberation cost after practice while preserving task success on reminted instances
minimal_negative_twin: remove recurrence by presenting each skill structure once + N0
strongest_parent: best from-scratch planner/controller with no cross-episode compiled skill state + P0
falsifier: cost does not fall with justified reuse; success falls below parent; or the advantage remains when reuse is removed

label: Retrieval
inputs: a bounded store containing target and distractor records plus a query
required_behavior: select the target or sufficient evidence with fewer charged probes than exhaustive access at matched fidelity
minimal_negative_twin: reduce the store to one item or mark every record equally relevant + N0
strongest_parent: best query-independent scan/order or exhaustive scan under the same probe budget + P0
falsifier: probe savings vanish at matched fidelity; hidden index labels leak the target; or the advantage persists when selection is unnecessary

label: Consolidation
inputs: volatile traces with delayed reuse and an optional durable/compressed store with write cost
required_behavior: transfer information so delayed utility exceeds a no-transfer parent after charging transfer/storage cost
minimal_negative_twin: remove delayed recurrence or make volatile storage perfectly persistent at zero cost + N0
strongest_parent: best policy that retains only the original volatile/raw traces and performs no cross-store transfer + P0
falsifier: charged transfer never pays back; durable store receives forbidden future labels; or the gain persists when recurrence/persistence makes consolidation unnecessary

label: Forgetting
inputs: capacity-limited memory with obsolete/interfering records and a future query distribution
required_behavior: delete or deprioritize records so future utility after storage/retrieval cost exceeds retain-all under the same capacity
minimal_negative_twin: provide unlimited free storage with no interference/obsolescence + N0
strongest_parent: best retain-all policy under the same query distribution and, where feasible, same physical capacity via neutral eviction + P0
falsifier: selective deletion lowers net utility; future labels leak into deletion; or an advantage remains under unlimited noninterfering storage
